subject: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up / burn-rate check
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up / burn-rate check

Hi Alex / Dana -

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery + next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary of ask / context
- You're running a 30-day pilot (existing trial) to evaluate summarization + search for internal clinical docs.
- Current observed usage: ~120k tokens/day on avg over last 7 days (see attached pilot-usage-may.csv).
- You asked about unit economics and what a target price looks like for predictable cost ($/1M tokens) once you scale.
- You also requested a potential extension of the free credits if burn is slower than expected.

Clarifying questions we noted (please confirm):
1) Is the 120k tokens/day expected to stay steady once you add tagging & longer context, or do you expect spikes during batch jobs?
2) Target budget range for production (monthly)? You mentioned a $3k-$10k/mo initial budget but please confirm whether that's for the team or org-wide.
3) Are we evaluating Dedicated or hosted API for the pilot-to-prod path? (affects unit cost assumptions)

Pricing / unit economics (ballpark) - for planning only
- Hosted API reference: $15-$40 per 1M tokens depending on model family & quantization.
- With batching, caching, and an optimized smaller decoder model we typically target the low-mid point ($20-$25 / 1M tokens) for retrieval+summarization workloads.
- If you expect sustained volume >50M tokens/mo we'll review Dedicated pricing and committed discounts (can go below $10 / 1M at scale depending on commit).

Pilot credits extension
- We're happy to consider an extension depending on actual burn. If you're below the 200k tokens/week threshold we usually extend a small top-up (+500k tokens) pending manager approval.
- If you confirm expected weekly burn and your current remaining credits we can route approval today.

Next steps
- Alex / Dana: confirm (A) expected weekly token burn over next 2-3 weeks, (B) whether budget $3k-$10k/mo is accurate, and (C) preference for hosted vs Dedicated.
- I'll prepare a short pricing note and escalate credits extension to my manager (cc'ing Rishi).

Thanks - happy to hop on a 15-min follow-up if that's easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: pilot-usage-may.csv (CSV summary of token/day, sessions)

From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Li <dana.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up / burn-rate check

Thanks Marissa - helpful summary. Quick answers: 

1) The 120k/day is likely conservative. Once we flip on nightly batch ingestion (longer context + full record parsing) we expect short spikes up to 300k tokens/day for 2-3 days/month. Most days will be in the 100-200k band.
2) Budget: the $3k-$10k/mo was for the immediate product team. There's a separate clinical analytics org that, if we roll to prod, could add another ~$20k/mo. So short-term pilot budget = $3k-$10k; production could be $20k-$30k+/mo depending on scope.
3) For pilot we prefer hosted API to move faster; Dedicated is on the roadmap if we commit to production throughput.

Credits: our burn has been slower during the first 2 weeks of the pilot due to onboarding. We're at ~1.3M tokens remaining of the trial. Would appreciate a +500k top-up and a 14-day extension so we can complete the ingestion run.

If you can route that we'll keep going - happy to set a 15-min check-in next week.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Taylor
Head of Product, Acme Health
alex.taylor@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up / burn-rate check

Great - thanks for the details Alex. That helps.

I've started the internal approval flow for a +500k token top-up and a 14-day extension. Rishi / Vivek - I've cc'd you for policy FYI and approval.

For pricing planning: with your expected spikes we'd model 100-200k day baseline + 2-3 spike days/month at 300k. If production moves to the $20k-$30k/mo range, that aligns with 20-40M tokens/mo depending on model choices.

I'll keep you posted - if approved I'll share the credits stub and the short pricing note with a recommended $/1M target for your initial commit (I'm thinking $22 / 1M as a reasonable starting point for hosted API with optimizations).

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up / burn-rate check

Marissa / Rishi - I reviewed the request. Approved: +500,000 trial tokens and a 14-day extension for Acme Health (deal ACME-2027-PILOT).

Notes:
- This is a one-time top-up tied to pilot evaluation only; we'll re-evaluate if usage exceeds the projected spikes.
- Finance should not invoice for the granted tokens; this is a credits grant.
- Marissa: please attach the credits-approval-stub.pdf to the thread and confirm expiration date in the grant email.

Vivek
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dana Li <dana.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing follow-up / burn-rate check

Alex / Dana - good news, approved. See details below and attached stub.

Credits grant (approved)
- Amount: 500,000 tokens top-up
- Extension: 14 days added to current trial period (new expiration: 2027-06-03)
- Note: one-time pilot grant, subject to review if burn exceeds projections.

Pricing note (short)
- Recommended starting target: $22 / 1M tokens for hosted API with batching + small decoder model.
- If you hit sustained monthly volumes >40M tokens we'll discuss Dedicated pricing (discounted tiers, commit-based).
- Actions you can take to reduce unit cost: enable prefix caching for repeated contexts, use a distilled model for summarization, and batch inference for long sessions.

Next steps
- I've attached credits-approval-stub.pdf and the pilot-usage-may.csv for your records.
- Please confirm receipt; I'll update the HubSpot deal (ACME-2027-PILOT) with the credits grant and new expiration.
- If helpful, I can book a 15-min technical check with our Solutions Engineer to optimize batching settings before your big ingestion run.

Thanks - excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: credits-approval-stub.pdf, pilot-usage-may.csv
